p4bj758m.sourceDescription: The vivid artificial cypress tree is crafted with 173 lifelike branch tips for a natural look. Delicate clusters of withered branches and 15 sprigs of vibrant red berries add layers of color and authentic detail, perfectly capturing the essence of winter. Illuminated by 70 warm white LED lights, the potted Xmas tree brings a soft, festive glow to any space. The cordless setup is effortless, thanks to the IP44 waterproof battery box that lets you display the tree without the restriction of cable length. Constructed from premium PE material, the pre-lit 4 ft Christmas tree is both flame-retardant and smell-free, ensuring safety. A weighted, cement-filled base offers reliable stability, preventing tipping in busy entryways or porches. Hence, the 2 pack Christmas trees will welcome the holiday spirit into your home with elegance and style. Lifelike Greenery: The pre-lit Christmas tree features 173 verdant branch tips that highly restore the real cypress leaves. Furthermore, there are vivid twigs and 15 clusters of vibrant red berries, filling your space with a festive and authentic holiday charm. Battery-operated Illumination: Fitted with 70 LED lights, the 4 ft Christmas tree delivers a warm touch to your seasonal decoration. The IP44 waterproof battery box ensures safe, easy control. Plus, the built-in timer keeps the lights on for 6 hours, off for Need 3 AA batteries (not included). Safe Material & Increased Stability: Crafted from PE material, the branches are flame-resistant and non-allergenic, providing peace of mind for indoor decorating. Each tree is anchored by a weighted base that keeps it upright and stable, making it resilient against busy holiday gatherings. Compact Festival Accent: The 4 ft set of 2 artificial cypress trees brings seasonal cheer to a wide variety of space, which are perfect for front porches, living room corners, offices, entryways, hallways or stores. Simple Assembly: Coming with a tree section and a base, the potted entrance tree can be quickly put together. Then you just have to simple arrange the branches to your liking and switch on the lights for immediate, inviting holiday sparkle. 18cd0nte.sourceDescription: This elegant Artificial Christmas Tree blends modern style with traditional charm, featuring a sleek cone shape that enhances its visual appeal. Designed to be adorned with warm white decorative LED lights, it brings festive charm to any room or terrace, creating a cozy ambiance for the Christmas season. With a theme dedicated to Christmas, this tree is suitable for various holiday settings, providing a delightful focal point for indoor or outdoor decor. Its clean lines and minimal ornamentation complement contemporary living spaces while offering a functional holiday solution for families, event hosts, and festive enthusiasts. PVC and PE Materials: This tree is crafted from premium PE and PVC materials, ensuring both durability and an authentic look. These materials are known for being flame retardant, adding a layer of safety to your holiday setup. The tree maintains a vibrant green appearance without fading, providing an evergreen display that lasts all season. The combination of these materials brings realism to your festive decorations, offering a reliable and attractive solution for annual celebrations. Decorative LED String Lights: Equipped with warm white LED string lights, this tree illuminates your space with a gentle glow. The lights come with 8 flash modes, allowing you to adjust the lighting to fit your mood—whether you’re hosting a festive gathering or enjoying a silent night in. This lighting feature also enhances the tree’s ornamental value, making it a standout piece in your holiday décor. USB Power Source: This tree includes a USB power source, offering flexibility in where it can be displayed indoors or outdoors. The USB feature eliminates the need for traditional power outlets, making setup convenient and practical. It is an ideal choice for modern homes where power access is limited, ensuring the tree can be placed almost anywhere. Versatile Room Placement: Suitable for both indoor and outdoor spaces, this tree offers a versatile solution for holiday decorating. Whether it's in a living room corner, a garden patio, or a terrace, its adaptable size complements various environments and styles. The tree acts as a festive connector among friends and families during yearly seasonal celebrations. Care and Setup Instructions: Assembly requires two individuals for easy setup following the manufacturer’s instructions. Ensure proper placement and stability of the synthetic plastic stand for an upright and secure display throughout the holiday season. Its simple assembly process allows you to focus more on enjoying the festive period. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PE and PVC Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 90 cm Stand size: 40 cm Durable Lifelike tips Hinged Construction for Set up Foldable Stand Number of PVC tips: 180 Number of baubles: 120 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 300 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmastree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 40 x 3 cm ball 40 x 4 cm ball 40 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
